verdict.rationale: ClickUp ships its own AI agents (Brain², Super Agent, custom agents), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair axis for this product. The evidence only documents ClickUp's own MCP server, which external AI assistants connect to. That is the server role and does not count here. Brain²'s built-in connectors to Google Drive, GitHub and Salesforce are adjacent native integrations, not user-pluggable MCP servers, so nothing shows ClickUp acting as an MCP client.
